title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統~Venice MOSE flood barriers
focus: 浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合~Coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response
summary: 本課以威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統為入口，深入浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Venice MOSE flood barriers as its entry point, this course examines coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 靜水壓敏感度固定ρ=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及大氣壓101.3 kPa，只將水深8 m增為10 m。表壓ρgh由80.442增至100.5525 kPa，增加25%；絕壓則由181.742增至201.8525 kPa，其增幅不是25%。比較只包含靜水柱，不推定送氣管損、閘門浮力或動態壓力同步變化。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For hydrostatic sensitivity, hold ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa fixed, increasing only depth from 8 m to 10 m. Gauge pressure ρgh rises from 80.442 to 100.5525 kPa, or 25%; absolute pressure rises from 181.742 to 201.8525 kPa, not by 25%. This column calculation does not infer pipe losses, gate buoyancy or dynamic pressures.
history: 威尼斯MOSE在潟湖海口配置多組浮動翻板，讓防潮、通航和潟湖環境成為彼此牽動的系統問題。七月十日全部七十八座閘門試升，不等同全部工程竣工。 十月三日市政府記錄首次實際防潮事件。 美國工兵團出版機電設計手冊作本課技術比較，並非威尼斯事件。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~Venice MOSE places groups of buoyant flap gates at lagoon inlets, coupling flood exclusion, navigation and the lagoon environment. All seventy-eight gates rise in the July ten test, distinct from full project completion. The municipality records the first actual flood-protection event on October three. USACE publishes mechanical-electrical guidance used for comparison, not a Venice project event. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 浮力翻轉與重心~Buoyant rotation and centroids
units.title: 浮力翻轉與重心~Buoyant rotation and centroids
units.mechanism: 翻板內水被空氣置換後，浮力和自重對鉸軸的力矩改變，門體才會轉動。上浮不是氣壓直接把整片門推出水面，還必須考慮外部水壓和重心位置。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。 氣室進水不均會移動重心，改變各鉸座受力。若把完全浸沒的浮力公式沿用到出水後，排水體積與力臂都會錯，進而誤判平衡角度。~Replacing internal water with air changes buoyancy and weight moments about the hinge. Rotation is not simply air pressure pushing the entire gate upward; external pressure and centroid positions also matter. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Unequal flooding shifts the center of gravity and hinge reactions. Reusing fully submerged buoyancy after emergence gives incorrect displacement and lever arms, leading to a false equilibrium angle.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture.
units.verify: 以門角、內外水位與艙氣壓同步重建排水體積，將浮心與重心分開定位；檢查力矩符號是否隨角度改變，避免只比較總浮力與重量。逐角度積分濕潤體積與浮心位置，確認門體開始露出水面後仍使用正確幾何。~Reconstruct displacement from synchronized angle, internal and external levels and air pressure. Locate buoyancy and gravity centroids separately and check moment signs as angle changes instead of comparing forces alone. Integrate wetted volume and buoyancy centroid at each angle, checking geometry after the gate begins emerging above water.
units.failure: 氣室進水不均會移動重心，改變各鉸座受力。若把完全浸沒的浮力公式沿用到出水後，排水體積與力臂都會錯，進而誤判平衡角度。~Unequal flooding shifts the center of gravity and hinge reactions. Reusing fully submerged buoyancy after emergence gives incorrect displacement and lever arms, leading to a false equilibrium angle.
units.misconception: 總浮力大於自重就能直接決定翻板的唯一平衡角。~Buoyancy exceeding weight directly determines the unique flap equilibrium angle.
units.practice: 以浮力翻轉與重心編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以門角、內外水位與艙氣壓同步重建排水體積，將浮心與重心分開定位；檢查力矩符號是否隨角度改變，避免只比較總浮力與重量。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for buoyant rotation and centroids, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct displacement from synchronized angle, internal and external levels and air pressure. Locate buoyancy and gravity centroids separately and check moment signs as angle changes instead of comparing forces alone.

units.anchor: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力~Air pressure and absolute pressure
units.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力~Air pressure and absolute pressure
units.mechanism: 排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。把表壓帶入氣體體積換算，會造成系統性的質量估算錯誤。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。~Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure. Inserting gauge pressure into volume conversion systematically miscalculates air mass. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics.
units.verify: 標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。用靜止水柱核驗表壓轉換，檢查導壓管高差是否被正確加回水深推估。~Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements. Verify gauge conversion with a stationary water column and check that impulse-line elevation is correctly included in depth inference.
units.failure: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。~Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.
units.misconception: 氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。~Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure.
units.practice: 以氣壓水深與絕對壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air pressure and absolute pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements.

units.anchor: 空氣供應與壓縮功~Air supply and compression work
units.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功~Air supply and compression work
units.mechanism: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。理想等溫模型提供能耗下界，不能代表真實機組效率。 假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。 壓縮熱若未散去，等溫假設會低估功率；漏氣又使供氣量不等於有效排水量。把氣量和門體位移直接一對一換算，會漏掉可壓縮儲能。~Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency. Delivered volume is not free-air volume at the same pressure. Ideal isothermal work is a lower-bound model, not an actual machine rating. Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa. Ideal isothermal power p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW, excluding mechanical and thermal losses. Incomplete heat rejection makes the isothermal estimate optimistic, and leakage separates supplied air from effective displacement. Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa. Ideal isothermal power p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW, excluding mechanical and thermal losses.
units.verify: 記錄流量換算的參考溫壓，對照壓縮機入口出口狀態和電功率；用儲氣壓力變化核對總氣量平衡，避免把瞬時充氣量當長期平均。用入口質量流率與儲氣質量增量閉合空氣平衡，另列溫升和漏氣造成的差額。~Record flow reference temperature and pressure, comparing compressor inlet and outlet states with electrical power. Cross-check air balance using storage-pressure change rather than treating transient filling as a steady average. Close inlet mass flow against stored-air mass increase and separately identify differences caused by heating and leakage.
units.failure: 壓縮熱若未散去，等溫假設會低估功率；漏氣又使供氣量不等於有效排水量。把氣量和門體位移直接一對一換算，會漏掉可壓縮儲能。~Incomplete heat rejection makes the isothermal estimate optimistic, and leakage separates supplied air from effective displacement. Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system.
units.misconception: 供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。~Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume.
units.practice: 以空氣供應與壓縮功編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。記錄流量換算的參考溫壓，對照壓縮機入口出口狀態和電功率；用儲氣壓力變化核對總氣量平衡，避免把瞬時充氣量當長期平均。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air supply and compression work, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record flow reference temperature and pressure, comparing compressor inlet and outlet states with electrical power. Cross-check air balance using storage-pressure change rather than treating transient filling as a steady average.

units.anchor: 鉸座荷載分配~Hinge reaction distribution
units.title: 鉸座荷載分配~Hinge reaction distribution
units.mechanism: 多鉸座承受門體合力時，構件剛度與安裝高差控制分配，均分只適用對稱理想情況。局部接觸與變形會讓一個鉸座先承載。 假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。~When several hinges share a gate resultant, stiffness and installation offsets govern distribution. Equal sharing is an ideal symmetric case; local contact and deformation may load one support first. Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m. Reactions are R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN and R2=2.25 MN, for a rigid gate under planar loading. Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m. Reactions are R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN and R2=2.25 MN, for a rigid gate under planar loading.
units.verify: 把鉸座幾何、軸承間隙和應變訊號一起核對，確認反力和等於外載且力矩平衡；不同門角分別作圖，找出接觸改變的轉折。將左右反力差與外載偏心量對照，檢查殘差是否跟門角或軸承接觸變化一致。~Compare hinge geometry, bearing clearance and strain, checking that reactions sum to applied load and balance its moment. Plot separate gate angles to identify changes in contact. Compare reaction difference with load eccentricity and test whether residuals track gate angle or changes in bearing contact.
units.failure: 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。~Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing.
units.misconception: 只要有兩座鉸鏈，每座就永遠承受一半荷載。~With two hinges each always carries exactly half the applied load.
units.practice: 以鉸座荷載分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把鉸座幾何、軸承間隙和應變訊號一起核對，確認反力和等於外載且力矩平衡；不同門角分別作圖，找出接觸改變的轉折。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hinge reaction distribution, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare hinge geometry, bearing clearance and strain, checking that reactions sum to applied load and balance its moment. Plot separate gate angles to identify changes in contact.

units.anchor: 波浪激振與自振~Wave excitation and natural period
units.title: 波浪激振與自振~Wave excitation and natural period
units.mechanism: 浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。乾態模態不能直接替代濕態動力特性。 假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。 大角度運動會改變浮力剛度，破壞線性週期假設；相鄰門片的流體耦合也會產生集體模態。以單片門的小振幅結果代表整列，可能漏掉相對運動。~A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia. Excitation near its natural frequency can amplify motion, so dry structural modes cannot replace wet dynamic properties. Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances. Large angles alter restoring stiffness and invalidate a linear period. Hydrodynamic coupling produces collective modes, so a single-gate small-motion result can miss relative movement across the full barrier.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances.
units.verify: 比較門角和波面頻譜，辨認相位及阻尼而非只找相同頻率；在不同水深重估附加慣性，確認觀測峰值不是感測器安裝共振。以相位跨越與衰減包絡交叉確認共振，而非只用頻譜上單一尖峰作判定。~Compare angle and wave spectra, examining phase and damping rather than frequency coincidence alone. Reassess added inertia at different depths and rule out resonance of sensor mountings. Confirm resonance through phase transition and decay envelopes rather than relying on one isolated spectral peak.
units.failure: 大角度運動會改變浮力剛度，破壞線性週期假設；相鄰門片的流體耦合也會產生集體模態。以單片門的小振幅結果代表整列，可能漏掉相對運動。~Large angles alter restoring stiffness and invalidate a linear period. Hydrodynamic coupling produces collective modes, so a single-gate small-motion result can miss relative movement across the full barrier.
units.misconception: 浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。~A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period.
units.practice: 以波浪激振與自振編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較門角和波面頻譜，辨認相位及阻尼而非只找相同頻率；在不同水深重估附加慣性，確認觀測峰值不是感測器安裝共振。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wave excitation and natural period, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare angle and wave spectra, examining phase and damping rather than frequency coincidence alone. Reassess added inertia at different depths and rule out resonance of sensor mountings.

units.anchor: 相鄰門片相對位移~Relative motion between gates
units.title: 相鄰門片相對位移~Relative motion between gates
units.mechanism: 兩片門同方向移動時，相對間隙可能很小；反相時則可能最大。接觸風險取決於相對運動與公差，不能只看每片門的最大位移。 假設兩門邊緣振幅各0.04 m、相位差120°，相對振幅√(A1²+A2²−2A1A2cosφ)=0.06928 m；同頻正弦近似。 兩套感測器若時鐘不一致，可能製造假的反相訊號。反之只存最大振幅會丟失相位，無法判定是否同時接近，造成不必要或不足的碰撞評估。~Two gates moving together can have small relative displacement, while opposing phases can maximize it. Contact risk depends on relative motion and tolerances, not each gate maximum independently. Assume edge amplitudes 0.04 m each and phase difference 120°. Relative amplitude √(A1²+A2²−2A1A2cosφ)=0.06928 m, for equal-frequency sinusoidal motion. Unsynchronized clocks can create a false out-of-phase response. Saving only maximum amplitudes loses phase, preventing determination of simultaneous approach and producing either excessive or insufficient collision assessment.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩門邊緣振幅各0.04 m、相位差120°，相對振幅√(A1²+A2²−2A1A2cosφ)=0.06928 m；同頻正弦近似。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume edge amplitudes 0.04 m each and phase difference 120°. Relative amplitude √(A1²+A2²−2A1A2cosφ)=0.06928 m, for equal-frequency sinusoidal motion.
units.verify: 同步量測相鄰門角並換算同一高度的邊緣位移，保留相位資訊；把靜態公差、熱變形與動態間隙分列，檢查時間同步誤差。把兩邊位移原始時序直接相減，對照相位公式並量化時間戳誤差對結果的影響。~Synchronize adjacent gate angles and convert them to edge displacement at one elevation. Retain phase and separate static tolerance, thermal distortion and dynamic clearance, checking synchronization error. Subtract raw edge-displacement histories directly, compare with the phase formula and quantify sensitivity to timestamp error.
units.failure: 兩套感測器若時鐘不一致，可能製造假的反相訊號。反之只存最大振幅會丟失相位，無法判定是否同時接近，造成不必要或不足的碰撞評估。~Unsynchronized clocks can create a false out-of-phase response. Saving only maximum amplitudes loses phase, preventing determination of simultaneous approach and producing either excessive or insufficient collision assessment.
units.misconception: 兩片門振幅相同就表示它們沒有相對運動。~Two gates with equal amplitudes have no relative motion between them.
units.practice: 以相鄰門片相對位移編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測相鄰門角並換算同一高度的邊緣位移，保留相位資訊；把靜態公差、熱變形與動態間隙分列，檢查時間同步誤差。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for relative motion between gates, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Synchronize adjacent gate angles and convert them to edge displacement at one elevation. Retain phase and separate static tolerance, thermal distortion and dynamic clearance, checking synchronization error.

units.anchor: 關閉潟湖降雨收支~Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon
units.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支~Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon
units.mechanism: 防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。水面面積使水位對體積敏感度不同，內部風致增水又會打破均勻水位假設。 假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。~Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. Surface area controls stage sensitivity to volume, while wind setup can invalidate a uniform water level assumption. Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage. Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage.
units.verify: 對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。將潟湖不同岸邊水位相減辨識風致坡度，再以全域平均驗算降雨增加的總庫容。~Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance. Use stations on different shores to identify wind setup instead of attributing all local rise to rainfall. Difference shoreline levels to identify wind setup, then use the domain average to check rainfall-related storage increase.
units.failure: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。~Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores.
units.misconception: 海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。~Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.
units.practice: 以關閉潟湖降雨收支編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance. Use stations on different shores to identify wind setup instead of attributing all local rise to rainfall.

units.anchor: 鹽分混合與交換~Salinity mixing and exchange
units.title: 鹽分混合與交換~Salinity mixing and exchange
units.mechanism: 鹽分守恆可追蹤海水與淡水比例，但潟湖並非瞬間完全混合。底層密度流和局部滯水會讓平均鹽度掩蓋生態差異。 假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。 底層高鹽水可在表面變淡時仍滯留，造成密度分層並限制氧氣交換。把所有鹽度變化都歸因於門片動作，會漏掉河流、風和蒸發影響。~Salt conservation tracks seawater and freshwater fractions, but a lagoon does not mix instantly. Bottom density currents and stagnant regions allow a mean salinity to conceal ecological variation. Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing. New salinity is 30×100/105=28.571 g/kg, without evaporation. Saline bottom water can remain after surface freshening, maintaining stratification and limiting oxygen exchange. Attributing every salinity change to gate movement overlooks river, wind and evaporation effects.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing. New salinity is 30×100/105=28.571 g/kg, without evaporation.
units.verify: 採集表中底層鹽溫剖面，核對混合前後水量與導電度校正；對照潮相與支流入流，判斷單一平均值是否足以描述鹽分分布。以各層水量加權鹽度重建總鹽質量，檢查表面淡化是否只是分層而非整體排鹽。~Sample surface, middle and bottom salinity-temperature profiles and verify volume balance and conductivity calibration. Compare tides and tributary inputs to test whether one average adequately describes the distribution. Reconstruct total salt from layer-volume-weighted salinity and check whether surface freshening reflects stratification rather than salt removal.
units.failure: 底層高鹽水可在表面變淡時仍滯留，造成密度分層並限制氧氣交換。把所有鹽度變化都歸因於門片動作，會漏掉河流、風和蒸發影響。~Saline bottom water can remain after surface freshening, maintaining stratification and limiting oxygen exchange. Attributing every salinity change to gate movement overlooks river, wind and evaporation effects.
units.misconception: 平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。~Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
units.practice: 以鹽分混合與交換編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。採集表中底層鹽溫剖面，核對混合前後水量與導電度校正；對照潮相與支流入流，判斷單一平均值是否足以描述鹽分分布。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for salinity mixing and exchange, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Sample surface, middle and bottom salinity-temperature profiles and verify volume balance and conductivity calibration. Compare tides and tributary inputs to test whether one average adequately describes the distribution.

units.anchor: 壓力量測與不確定度~Pressure measurement uncertainty
units.title: 壓力量測與不確定度~Pressure measurement uncertainty
units.mechanism: 以壓力反推水深時，密度與感測誤差都進入結果。壓力計精度不是整體水位精度，導壓高程、氣泡和溫度也需要校核。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設壓力標準不確定度500 Pa、密度1025 kg/m³且暫視為精確，uh=up/(ρg)=0.04973 m；僅此誤差分量，非總誤差。 共同導壓管堵塞會讓多支感測器一致但錯誤，不能用數字吻合當獨立證據。若海水密度變動仍沿用淡水換算，也會產生持續水深偏差。~Inferring depth from pressure involves both density and sensor error. Transducer accuracy is not complete level accuracy because tapping elevation, trapped air and temperature also require checking. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume pressure standard uncertainty 500 Pa and density 1025 kg/m³ treated as exact. uh=up/(ρg)=0.04973 m, representing this component only rather than total error. A shared blocked impulse line can make several sensors agree incorrectly. Agreement is not independence, and using freshwater density for changing seawater creates a persistent inferred-depth bias.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設壓力標準不確定度500 Pa、密度1025 kg/m³且暫視為精確，uh=up/(ρg)=0.04973 m；僅此誤差分量，非總誤差。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume pressure standard uncertainty 500 Pa and density 1025 kg/m³ treated as exact. uh=up/(ρg)=0.04973 m, representing this component only rather than total error.
units.verify: 以可追溯壓力基準校正量測鏈，檢查零點和跨度，再與獨立水位及溫鹽資料比較；把隨機不確定度和共同基準偏差分開列帳。另以密度不確定度傳播計算水深影響，對共同基準偏差採獨立外部測量核驗。~Calibrate the measurement chain with a traceable pressure reference, checking zero and span. Compare independent level and temperature-salinity data, separating random uncertainty from common datum bias. Propagate density uncertainty separately and use independent external measurements to test common reference bias in inferred depth.
units.failure: 共同導壓管堵塞會讓多支感測器一致但錯誤，不能用數字吻合當獨立證據。若海水密度變動仍沿用淡水換算，也會產生持續水深偏差。~A shared blocked impulse line can make several sensors agree incorrectly. Agreement is not independence, and using freshwater density for changing seawater creates a persistent inferred-depth bias.
units.misconception: 壓力感測器讀數一致就證明共同取壓管沒有問題。~Matching pressure readings prove the shared impulse connection has no defect.
units.practice: 以壓力量測與不確定度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以可追溯壓力基準校正量測鏈，檢查零點和跨度，再與獨立水位及溫鹽資料比較；把隨機不確定度和共同基準偏差分開列帳。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure measurement uncertainty, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate the measurement chain with a traceable pressure reference, checking zero and span. Compare independent level and temperature-salinity data, separating random uncertainty from common datum bias.

units.title: 供氣網路可用度~Air-network availability
units.mechanism: 供氣系統由壓縮、儲存、分配與閥件共同構成，備援壓縮機無法補償所有共用管路故障。可靠度必須先定義功能成功條件再計算。 假設兩台獨立壓縮機可用度各0.98、任一足夠，並串聯共同分配系統0.99；A=(1−0.02²)×0.99=0.989604，忽略修復動態。 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。~Air supply comprises compression, storage, distribution and valves. A spare compressor cannot compensate for every shared-pipe fault, so reliability calculations require a defined functional success condition. Assume two independent compressors each available 0.98, either sufficient, in series with distribution availability 0.99. A=(1−0.02²)×0.99=0.989604, excluding repair dynamics. A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩台獨立壓縮機可用度各0.98、任一足夠，並串聯共同分配系統0.99；A=(1−0.02²)×0.99=0.989604，忽略修復動態。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume two independent compressors each available 0.98, either sufficient, in series with distribution availability 0.99. A=(1−0.02²)×0.99=0.989604, excluding repair dynamics.
units.verify: 從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。以末端壓力和流量證明功能交付，檢查共用分配管故障是否仍能使備機失去作用。~Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections. Verify that a spare truly provides required flow and use historical failure categories to test independence assumptions. Demonstrate terminal pressure and flow delivery and test whether shared distribution faults still defeat the standby unit.
units.failure: 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。~A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain.
units.misconception: 備援壓縮機能啟動就保證末端閥件取得足夠供氣。~A starting standby compressor guarantees sufficient air delivery at terminal valves.
units.practice: 以供氣網路可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air-network availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections. Verify that a spare truly provides required flow and use historical failure categories to test independence assumptions.
